title: Company Registry & Filings Aggregator input
description: Look up official entity-level company registry or SEC filing records for AI company research, due diligence briefs, and firmographic enrichment.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Official APIs to query. Use SEC EDGAR for no-key US company and filing lookups. Use UK Companies House only when you provide a Companies House API key.

query.title: Search query
query.description: Company name, ticker, or broad search term. Agents should use a specific company name or ticker when possible.

companyNames.title: Company names
companyNames.description: Optional list of company names or tickers to search for batch company research.

companyNumbers.title: Companies House numbers
companyNumbers.description: Optional direct UK Companies House company numbers for precise entity lookup.

ciks.title: SEC CIKs
ciks.description: Optional direct SEC CIK identifiers for precise SEC entity lookup.

maxResults.title: Maximum records
maxResults.description: Maximum clean company/entity records to save. Use 1-10 for agent calls and focused due diligence.

companiesHouseApiKey.title: Companies House API key
companiesHouseApiKey.description: Free Companies House API key. Required only when UK Companies House is selected. You may also set COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY.

secUserAgent.title: SEC User-Agent
secUserAgent.description: SEC requires an application identity and contact email in User-Agent. Replace contact@example.com with a monitored email for production use.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Not required for official JSON APIs, included for Apify compatibility.
